name: v32 Fixed Channel Scaling x Scalar Range Search Local 2x2 Diagnostic
interpretation: Exploratory screening on previously viewed articles and fixed v24 rows; no blind generalization claim
article_unit: 16 complete 2048-token WT2 train articles per search or held group; no token splitting
prefix: fixed v18 M2 quantized prefix, identical v23/v24 cached inputs for all four arms
original_weight: base model checkpoint tensor converted to FP16 exactly as v24; verify pristine SHA against v24 sidecar

arms.G00: original coordinates, native dynamic GPTQ alpha=1; saved v24 score/candidate reused
arms.G01: original coordinates, v24 scalar10 search-selected alpha; saved v24 score/candidate reused
arms.G10: one frozen activation-derived D, transformed-coordinate dynamic GPTQ alpha=1
arms.G11: same frozen D, transformed-coordinate dynamic GPTQ scalar10 search-selected alpha

scale_definition.source: only the split's 16 search articles and same frozen input cache
scale_definition.a_j: mean(abs(X[:,j])) over 32768 search tokens; FP16 cache converted to FP32; FP64 reduction

hessian.source: fresh native GPTQ.process_batch on Xprime FP16 search documents, in exact document order
hessian.initialization: FP32 zero square matrix and nsamples=0
hessian.preparation: same v17.3 prepare_native_state: dead-column, damp=0.1*mean(diag), lower Cholesky, inverse, native final Cholesky

scoring.target: same original unquantized reference X_FP16.float()@W_FP16.float().T; bias cancels
scoring.input_chunk: 2 complete documents = 4096 tokens; 4 fixed output rows; FP32 GEMM and FP64 squared-sum accumulation
scoring.normalization: divide by 16*2048 tokens for each row
scoring.selection: argmin on search MSE over the original 10 alphas; exact ties choose larger alpha
scoring.held_use: score only G10 alpha1 and G11 search-selected row candidates after selection lock
scoring.baseline: reused v24/v31 original scalar10 search and held scores with exact source check
scoring.Qeff: optional diagnostic Qprime*D^-1 in FP32 only; not a packable original G128 weight

preflight.D_identity_requirements: rebuilt native H exact hash and alpha1 selected row Q/scales/zeros/g_idx exact vs v24
preflight.unquantized_equivalence: analytic identity, FP64 and FP32 spot on first 128 search tokens, FP16 conversion drift over full search and held scoring groups
preflight.scaled_native_alpha1_parity: for every target/split, compare optimized alpha1 to independent native_dynamic_gptq at identical Wprime/Hprime
preflight.candidate_independence: immutable pristine Wprime and prepared H; verify unchanged hashes after candidates and reversed-order spot

metrics.interaction: I=(L10-L11)-(L00-L01) on identical held documents and fixed rows; lower loss is better
metrics.wtl_epsilon: v24 HELD_REPEAT_NOISE.json per unit; frozen prior to v32
metrics.pooled_SSE: sum over fixed rows of per-row MSE*32768; never called whole-Linear output SSE
